text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Angolan government has made available $120,000 to an agriculture, fisheries and livestock credit fund in the municipality of Buca-Zau in cabinda province, the provincial government said on Friday.

- The new Bishop of the Angolan city of Bie, Jose Namnbi, was presented to a crowd of 5,000 people Sunday. The 48-year-old Namnbi replaces Pedro Luis Antonio who held the position for the past 18 years.
